title: How do you build a training matrix for a real estate agency?
seoTitle: Training matrix for a real estate agency
description: Build a real estate agency training matrix: license CE and CPD cycles, AML/CTF duties, agency roles, evidence rules and an illustrative grid by market.
shortAnswer: A real estate agency training matrix is built by listing every person who holds a license, registration or AML/CTF related role, then recording two separate clocks for each: the continuing education or CPD cycle tied to that person's license, and the anti-money laundering training tied to the job they do. Each cell names the market, the mandatory topics, the deadline, and the record a licensing regulator or AML supervisor would ask the agency to produce.
keyTakeaways: Agency training runs on two clocks: a license renewal cycle owned by the individual and a role based AML/CTF cycle owned by the agency.
Since July 1, 2026, Australian agencies that broker real estate sales are AML/CTF reporting entities, and AUSTRAC expects role appropriate training before a person starts an AML/CTF related role.
License cycles differ widely: NSW runs CPD from 1 July to 30 June, Texas renews every two years, Florida sets 14 hours per renewal period and California counts 45 hours over four years.
Generic vendor modules are not enough. AUSTRAC describes generic online training with no completion tracking or understanding checks as poor practice.
Victorian agents' representatives must be registered from 25 November 2026, and mandatory Victorian CPD starts on 1 April 2027.

sections.heading: Why does a real estate agency need two kinds of columns?

blocks.text: Because a real estate agency answers to two different kinds of regulator: a licensing authority that renews each agent's license only if continuing education is complete, and, in a growing number of markets, an anti-money laundering supervisor that judges whether the agency trained the people who deal with buyers and sellers. The first set of duties follows the person; the second follows the role.

The core method in [how to build a training matrix](/guides/how-to-build-a-training-matrix) still holds: people or roles down one side, requirements across the top, and a rule in each cell. An agency adds a license number, license class and expiry date to every row, because a missed CE deadline can stop an agent trading, while a gap in AML training is a failing of the business. Recording both against the same row stops one from hiding the other. A [training matrix](/glossary/training-matrix) built this way also shows principals which renewals fall due in the next quarter.

sections.heading: Which roles should a real estate agency list as rows?

blocks.text: List roles by the license class and the customer facing activity each one carries, not by office or team. The table below shows the rows most agencies need and the rule that makes each one distinct.

sections.heading: What does each market require of agency staff?

blocks.text: The columns come from the regulation pages for each market where the agency is licensed. Each summary below draws only on the linked page.

items: **Australia (AML/CTF).** Agencies that broker the sale, purchase or transfer of real estate are reporting entities, and the customer is both the seller and the buyer. Before anyone performs an AML/CTF related role, AUSTRAC expects initial personnel due diligence, confirmation of suitability and role appropriate training; while they stay in the role, ongoing due diligence, refresher training and performance monitoring. Contractors, consultants, volunteers and interns are covered too ([AML/CTF for real estate](/regulations/aml-ctf-tranche-2-real-estate-training)).

**New South Wales.** The CPD year runs 1 July to 30 June. For 2026-27, residential sales licensees complete 7 hours across 4 compulsory topics, property managers complete 7 hours including at least 4 hours on domestic and family violence, and Class 1 licensees also attend a 5 hour accredited forum and complete AUSTRAC's Smart real estate agent's guide to AML/CTF, which does not replace the compulsory AML/CTF topic. Assistant agents complete three Certificate IV units ([NSW real estate CPD](/regulations/nsw-real-estate-cpd-requirements)).

**Victoria.** From 1 April 2027, estate agents and agents' representatives must complete at least five CPD activities of at least one hour each year from 1 April to 31 March, including at least two mandatory activities set by the Business Licensing Authority with a written examination. Conferences, self-study and pre-recorded webinars do not count ([Victorian estate agent CPD](/regulations/victoria-estate-agent-cpd-requirements)).

**California.** Salespersons and brokers complete 45 clock hours of Department of Real Estate approved continuing education within the four years before renewal, including mandatory subjects such as ethics, agency, trust fund handling, fair housing with an interactive role play component and a two hour implicit bias course, plus at least 18 hours of consumer protection courses ([California real estate CE](/regulations/california-real-estate-continuing-education)).

**Florida.** After the first renewal, licensees complete at least 14 hours of 50 minutes in each renewal period: the 3 hour Core Law course, the 3 hour Business Ethics course and at least 8 hours of specialty courses. Before the first renewal, sales associates complete up to 45 hours and brokers up to 60 hours of post-licensing education, or the license is null and void ([Florida real estate CE](/regulations/florida-real-estate-continuing-education)).

**Texas.** Sales agents and brokers complete 18 hours for each two year renewal, including Legal Update I and II (4 hours each) and 3 hours on contracts. Sponsoring brokers, designated brokers and delegated supervisors take the 6 hour Broker Responsibility Course ([Texas real estate CE](/regulations/texas-real-estate-continuing-education)).

**Portugal, the EU and the UAE.** Real estate businesses appear among the obliged entities on the [Portugal AML law](/regulations/portugal-aml-law-training-requirements) page, where Article 55 of Law 83/2017 requires specific, regular training and immediate training for new joiners in AML roles. The [EU AMLR](/regulations/eu-amlr-training-requirements) lists real estate agents as obliged entities and applies from 10 July 2027. In the UAE, real estate brokers and agents are designated non-financial businesses, and Cabinet Resolution No. 134 of 2025 requires periodic programs and documented training plans ([UAE AML/CFT](/regulations/uae-aml-cft-training-requirements)).

sections.heading: Which deadlines follow the license and which follow the role?

blocks.text: License deadlines are fixed by the licensing regulator and attach to the individual; AML deadlines are mostly set by the agency's own program and attach to the job. Record the source of every date in the matrix so a reviewer can tell the two apart.

items: **Fixed by the license regulator.** NSW CPD by 30 June; Victorian CPD by 31 March from the 2027-28 year; Texas every two years; California within the four years before renewal; Florida in each renewal period after the first.

**Fixed by an event.** AUSTRAC expects training before a person performs an AML/CTF related role, and Florida post-licensing must be finished before the first renewal. Both belong in a trigger column, not just a calendar column.

**Chosen by the agency.** AUSTRAC requires refresher training while a person remains in the role but the real estate page gives no fixed interval, so the agency should write down why it picked its cycle. Guidance on [setting mandatory training refresh cycles](/guides/how-to-set-mandatory-training-refresh-cycles) covers how to justify a choice.

**Grace and deferral rules.** California allows a 90 day CE extension on request, and Texas allows sales agents (except in the first renewal period) and brokers to pay a $200 fee for 60 extra days. Track these as exceptions, not as the normal due date.

sections.heading: What records should an agency be ready to produce?

blocks.text: Keep proof of the specific course, the provider, the hours and the assessment, because licensing regulators audit individual CPD and AML supervisors look for evidence that training fit the business. A completion list on its own will not satisfy either.

items: **Retention periods.** NSW keeps CPD records for 3 years for licensees and 4 years for certificate holders; California licensees keep CE certificates for four years after renewal; Law 83/2017 Article 51 sets seven years in Portugal; Cabinet Resolution No. 134 of 2025 Article 25 sets five years in the UAE.

**Business specific AML content.** AUSTRAC states that its Smart agent's guide does not satisfy an agency's obligation to provide training specific to its own business and money laundering risks. Keep the agency's own risk based module and the date it was last reviewed.

**Understanding checks.** AUSTRAC's poor practice example is a 25 employee agency using generic online training with no completion tracking, refreshers or understanding checks. Keep test results, not just attendance.

**Provider evidence.** NSW compulsory topics must come from providers approved by the Strata and Property Services Commissioner, delivered face to face (maximum 40) or by webinar (maximum 25) with an assessment activity. Victoria requires activities from eligible providers. The guide on [preparing training records for an audit](/guides/how-to-prepare-training-records-for-an-audit) explains how to assemble the file.

sections.heading: Which real estate training dates fall in 2026 and 2027?

blocks.text: Several agency obligations started recently or start soon, so add them as dated rows now. As at November 2026, the regulation pages record these dates:

items: **1 July 2026, Australia:** real estate businesses that broker sales became AML/CTF reporting entities, with enrollment due within 28 days of starting a designated service.
**29 July 2026, Australia:** the latest date for newly regulated entities to notify their AML/CTF compliance officer, or 14 days after enrolling if later.
**25 November 2026, Victoria:** agents' representatives must hold a registration, and the Estate Agents (Education) Amendment Regulations 2026 come into operation.
**1 April 2027, Victoria:** the first mandatory CPD year begins for estate agents and agents' representatives, running to 31 March 2028.
**10 July 2027, EU:** the AMLR applies, with Article 12 requiring specific, ongoing, documented training for relevant employees, agents and distributors.

blocks.title: Small agency starter kit
blocks.text: AUSTRAC's real estate program starter kit is designed for businesses with 15 or fewer personnel and no fully remote self service. Larger agencies should expect to build their own program and training content rather than rely on the kit.

sections.heading: How does Knowledge Foundry approach this?

blocks.text: Knowledge Foundry maps each licensing and AML obligation to the roles it attaches to, the learning outcome it requires and the assessment that proves it, so an agency can show which module answers which rule. When a market adds a mandatory topic or a new reporting duty, the affected roles are flagged. See [compliance programs](/programs/compliance).

faqs.q: Does licensing CE count toward AML/CTF training in Australia?
faqs.a: Only partly. NSW requires Class 1 licensees in relevant areas to complete AUSTRAC's Smart real estate agent's guide, but NSW Fair Trading says it does not replace the compulsory AML/CTF CPD topic, and AUSTRAC says the guide does not meet the agency's duty to train on its own business risks. Keep separate columns for each.

faqs.q: Do administrative staff need AML/CTF training if they never sell property?
faqs.a: If they onboard customers, collect identification or handle settlement communications, they are likely in an AML/CTF related role. AUSTRAC's guidance applies personnel due diligence and training to employees and to contractors, consultants, volunteers, interns and service provider staff, so the deciding factor is the task, not the job title.

faqs.q: How should an agency track agents licensed in more than one state?
faqs.a: Give each license its own row or sub-row with its own expiry date and CE rule. Requirements do not transfer automatically: NSW, Victoria, California, Florida and Texas each set different hours, mandatory topics and cycles, and a course approved in one jurisdiction may not be accepted in another.

faqs.q: What happens if a Florida sales associate misses post-licensing education?
faqs.a: Section 475.17 of the Florida Statutes provides that the license of a sales associate or broker who does not complete post-licensing education before the first renewal is considered null and void. The matrix should flag first renewal dates for newly licensed staff well ahead of time.
